body:
Phase 1, the whole web client. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md.

Everything in the two Android tickets, on the web: contract types for the
new item field and the three list values; split and balance arithmetic as
pure modules with the SAME case table as Android (agreement to the cent);
duplicate-name check off for expense lists; new-list kind + currency; list
properties adjustments; overview card; expense list page; expense form;
balances page; nine catalogs + the cross-client fixture.
title: expenses: web — data layer, arithmetic, and all screens
